name: Singing Blue Shards
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, buyers seek Singing Blue Shards. The Venture Company makes it hard for Crank Fizzlebub to gather raw Singing Crystals, so he offers you a cut of the profits for ten shards taken from basilisk hides.

sections.title: A Lucrative Opportunity
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub has buyers for Singing Crystals, found only in Stranglethorn Vale. The Venture Company makes gathering raw crystals hard for him. So he seeks another way to get them. Basilisks eat the crystals, and the mineral becomes part of their hardened hides. You can recover usable shards there.

sections.title: Hunting the Coast
sections.body: Basilisks across the jungle may yield crystal fragments. Fizzlebub points you to the gentler ones along the northern shores south of Zul'Kunda. Bring him ten shards so he can move ahead with his buyers. Then his attention turns to the Venture Company's operations.

faq.q: Why does Crank Fizzlebub want Singing Crystal Shards?
faq.answer: Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn Vale, and select buyers value them highly. Crank Fizzlebub says he can sell them and offers you a cut of the profits.

faq.q: Why cannot Crank Fizzlebub harvest the crystals directly?
faq.answer: Fizzlebub says the Venture Company makes it hard for him to gather raw crystals himself.

faq.q: Why do basilisks have these crystals?
faq.answer: Basilisks in Stranglethorn Vale eat the crystals. The mineral becomes part of their hides and gives them their hard, rocky skin.

faq.q: Where does Crank Fizzlebub suggest looking for basilisks?
faq.answer: Fizzlebub says any basilisk may yield shards. Gentler ones live along the northern shores south of Zul'Kunda.

faq.q: What happens after turning in the shards?
aliases: what next after singing blue shards
faq.answer: When you bring Fizzlebub ten shards, he pays your promised cut of the profits. Then he turns his attention to the Venture Company's operations.
